parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: Restores ECS files.

OSS: Restores OSS objects.

NAS: Restores NAS files.

COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: Restores data to a CPFS file system.

OTS_TABLE: Restores an OTS table.

UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK: Restores an entire ECS instance
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：
ECS_FILE：恢复ECS文件。
OSS：恢复阿里云OSS。
NAS：恢复阿里云NAS。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：恢复到CPFS。
OTS_TABLE：恢复到阿里云OTS。
UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK：恢复到阿里云ECS整机
parameters.name: restore_type

fields.help_en:
The filter key. Valid values:

RegionId: region ID

PlanId: backup plan ID

JobId: backup job ID

VaultId: vault ID

InstanceId: ECS instance ID

Bucket: OSS bucket name

FileSystemId: file system ID

Status: job status

CompleteTime: completion time
fields.help_zh:
查询过滤器中的键值。取值包括：
RegionId：地域ID
PlanId：备份计划ID
JobId：备份任务ID
VaultId：仓库ID
InstanceId：ECS实例ID
Bucket：OSS Bucket名称
FileSystemId：文件系统ID
Status：任务状态
CompleteTime：任务结束时间
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: An array of values for the specified filter key
fields.help_zh: 查询过滤器中的待匹配的值
fields.name: values

fields.help_en:
The matching method. The default value is IN. Valid values:

EQUAL: Equal to

NOT_EQUAL: Not equal to

GREATER_THAN: Greater than

GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL: Greater than or equal to

LESS_THAN: Less than

LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL: Less than or equal to

BETWEEN: The value is within a specified range. The `Values` parameter must be a JSON array in the `[min, max]` format.

IN: The value is in a specified set. The `Values` parameter must be an array.

The IN operator is not supported when `Key` is CompleteTime
fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。默认为IN。即过滤器中Key和Value支持的匹配操作（Operator）方式，取值可包括：
EQUAL：等于
NOT_EQUAL：不等于
GREATER_THAN：大于
GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL：大于等于
LESS_THAN：小于
LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL：小于等于
BETWEEN：区间，value为JSON数组`[下届,上届]`。
IN：在集合中，value为数组。

当使用CompleteTime作为Key查询时，暂时不支持IN操作
fields.name: operator

parameters.help_en: The edition. Valid values: `BASIC` and `STANDARD`. Default value: `STANDARD`
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，支持BASIC和STANDARD，默认值为STANDARD
parameters.name: edition

Message.description_en: The response message. If the request is successful, "successful" is returned. Otherwise, an error message is returned

PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

RestoreJobs.description_en: A container for the restore job details

items.description_en: The details of a restore job

ActualBytes.description_en: The actual amount of data restored after deduplication, in bytes
ActualBytes.description_zh: 去除重复后恢复任务实际数据量。单位为字节

ActualItems.description_en: The actual number of files restored. This parameter is returned only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE
ActualItems.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示恢复任务实际项目数

BytesDone.description_en: The amount of data restored, in bytes
BytesDone.description_zh: 恢复的数据量。单位为字节

BytesTotal.description_en: The total size of the data source, in bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 数据源总数据量。单位为字节

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the client group used for the restore job

CompleteTime.description_en: The time when the restore job completed. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CompleteTime.description_zh: 恢复任务完成时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the restore job was created. This is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 恢复任务创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒

CrossAccountRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role that was assumed in the source account to perform the cross-account restore
CrossAccountRoleName.description_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名

CrossAccountType.description_en:
The type of the cross-account backup. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: a backup within the same account

CROSS_ACCOUNT: a cross-account backup
CrossAccountType.description_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份

CrossAccountUserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the backup data. This parameter is returned for cross-account restores
CrossAccountUserId.description_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID

ErrorFile.description_en: The list of files that failed to be restored

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message for the restore job

Exclude.description_en: The paths to files that were excluded from the restore job. This parameter is returned only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. Each path can be up to 255 characters long
Exclude.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示不需要进行恢复的路径，该路径下所有文件都不恢复。最多支持255个字符

ExpireTime.description_en: The time when the restore job expires

FailbackDetail.description_en: The details of the VMware failback job

Include.description_en: The paths to the files that are included in the restore job
Include.description_zh: 恢复任务包含的恢复路径

ItemsDone.description_en: The number of files that have been restored. This parameter is returned only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE
ItemsDone.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示恢复项目数

ItemsTotal.description_en: The total number of files in the data source. This parameter is returned only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE
ItemsTotal.description_zh: 仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，该参数有效。表示数据源项目总数

MeteringBytesDone.description_en: The billable amount of restored data, in bytes. This parameter is returned only when StorageClass is set to ARCHIVE. The value is rounded up to the nearest 1 MB
MeteringBytesDone.description_zh: 恢复的数据量。单位为字节。仅StorageClass=ARCHIVE时有效，按照1MB对齐

MeteringBytesTotal.description_en: The total billable amount of data in the data source, in bytes. This parameter is returned only when StorageClass is set to ARCHIVE. The value is rounded up to the nearest 1 MB
MeteringBytesTotal.description_zh: 数据源总数据量。单位为字节。仅StorageClass=ARCHIVE时有效，按照1MB对齐

Options.description_en:
The advanced restore options. This parameter is returned only if SourceType is set to ECS_FILE. It indicates whether Volume Shadow Copy Service (VSS) was used.

This feature is available only for Windows ECS instances.

The `["UseVSS":true]` option indicates that VSS was used to ensure data consistency, which is useful when the source data changes during the backup process.

If you use VSS, you cannot restore files from multiple directories at the same time
Options.description_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为ECS_FILE时，需要配置该参数。表示是否使用Windows系统VSS定义恢复路径。
此功能仅支持Windows类型ECS实例。
如果备份源中有数据更改，需要确保备份数据与源数据的一致时，才可配置为`["UseVSS":true]`。
选择使用VSS后，不支持多个文件目录同时恢复

ECS_FILE: ECS files

OSS: OSS objects

NAS: NAS files

UDM_ECS: ECS instance

数据源类型，取值范围：

恢复任务状态。取值范围：
